title: Toilet Paper Stand 27-Inch Solid Brass Euro Hook | Brushed Bronze | Carolina | Allied Brass
description:
Need a toilet paper holder without drilling into the wall? This freestanding toilet paper stand gives you a stable, space-saving way to keep a roll within easy reach—ideal when wall space is limited in Brushed Bronze, which features warm, earthy tones with a softly textured surface that adds depth to traditional and transitional bathrooms.

Highlights:
- Brushed Bronze brings rich depth and character
- Pairs with matching Carolina accessories for a warm, cohesive aesthetic
- Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- Coordinate a cohesive look; part of the Carolina Collection for matching Carolina accessories
- Built for lasting everyday use; crafted from solid brass construction

Specs & Installation:
- Product type: Freestanding toilet paper stand (Euro-style)
- Material: Solid brass
- Dimensions (L x H x W): 8 in. x 27 in. x 6 in.
- Assembly: Some assembly required
Multiple designer finish options available
- Warranty: Limited lifetime warranty
